findings.passage: This session, we strengthened Second Amendment rights and expanded personal freedoms. New laws ensure homeowners and renters can't be restricted from carrying concealed due to housing covenants, allow municipal and county employees to carry in more locations, including bars, and protect firearm privacy by preventing separate tracking of gun purchases. Additionally, college students now have the right to carry concealed on campus, ensuring equal access to self-defense.
findings.note: End-of-session newsletter from her campaign site. She describes the 2025 gun laws (housing covenants, carry by local government employees, no separate tracking of gun purchases, campus carry) as strengthening Second Amendment rights.
